name: ai-usage
description: The shared base: the workflow, the formats, the reuse rules and the tools behind them.

delivery.title: How the rules reach a session
delivery.description: rules (the default) copies them into ~/.claude/rules and the project's own .claude/rules; context hands them to each session instead.

cap_playwright.title: Hold Playwright to a share of the machine
cap_playwright.description: On by default: a Playwright run Claude starts goes through the plugin's capped runner, so it cannot take the desktop. Turn it off on a machine that does not need it.
